title: Chapter 51
text:
The machine gun in Zhang Wei's hands roared. Countless large-caliber bullets leaped out of the muzzle, dragging two distinct flame tails behind them. Like two flaming dragons, they swept and hit the two armored SUVs at the front. Five seconds later, the two armored SUVs actually burst into a ball of fire, forcibly exploding.

Lambert displayed his abilities as a sniper. He was as silent as a rock as he continued to fire. He used steel-core armor-piercing bullets, and every shot was effective. He hit the tires or the glass in front of the driver's seat, greatly slowing down the enemy's pursuit.

"Reinforcements are here!"

Ma Qing Yang, who was driving away, was overjoyed. His team members were filled with hope. Almost everyone in his team was injured, and they were lying on the ground like corpses.

When the car reached the top of the hill, Ma Qing Yang stuck his head out from the driver's seat and shouted, "Old Zhang, there are too many enemies. Run!"

At this moment, a strange gust of wind suddenly attacked Zhang Wei and the others from the bottom of the hill. The gust of wind stirred up the sand and dust, forming a ghost face with facial features. Everyone suddenly felt a burst of uneasiness in their minds.

"Dodge!" Zhang Wei roared. He quickly rolled to the ground. His armor was too heavy, so he could only use this method to dodge. Li Ya Lin and Lambert reacted the fastest and immediately moved to the side.

The gust of wind exploded in their original position, sending a few of the field team members flying.

Zhang Wei suddenly felt a sharp pain in his head, and blood flowed down his nose. He was shocked to find that the field team members who could not dodge in time were all bleeding from their orifices and twitching uncontrollably on the ground.

"Psychic attack! They have an Esper! " Zhang Wei was shocked. He took a closer look and saw that the roof of one of the armored vehicles had opened, and a slender figure wearing a black leather jacket jumped out. She rushed toward them at an extremely fast speed. Her long red curly hair fluttered in the wind like red and black lightning.

Hella's eyes were cold. She waved her hand, and another ghostly face quickly formed and blew toward Zhang Wei. The wind whistled in the air like a silent cry.

No, this was not the sound of wind.

This was the howl of a soul!

[Strength of the Dead] — Hella's Esper ability.

Zhang Wei's mind was in a mess, and he fell to the ground. If not for his strong physique, he would have died.

Han Xiao frowned. He pushed away Lin Yao, who was at a loss, and took over the command. "She is the Germinal Organization's combat executive. Retreat immediately!"

Zhang Wei was about to reprimand them when he saw that Li Ya Lin and Lambert did not hesitate at all. They turned around and left, completely trusting Han Xiao's judgment.

Which newbie was so trustworthy?

Zhang Wei was surprised and swallowed his words back into his stomach. He gritted his teeth and stood up, activating the thrusters on his leg armor. With each step, he could move five or six meters forward. He followed his two teammates and retreated quickly. From time to time, he would turn around and shoot to obstruct Hella's pursuit.

Hella quickly rushed to the top of the hill. With a wave of her hand, a gray light swept past. The field team that could not dodge in time all fell to the ground. There were no external injuries, but they stopped breathing.

Han Xiao's gaze was solemn. He had long known that Hella was powerful. Thankfully, when he escaped from the laboratory, he did not meet Hella head-on. Her Esper Ability was a Super Rare Ability that was evaluated as having S-Grade potential, exceeding the Calamity Grade.

The current Hella had only scratched the surface of her Esper Ability, and that was already very powerful.

"She's too fast. Li Ya Lin, stop her!"

Li Ya Lin turned around without hesitation and whipped out a kick. A bright yellow aura exploded, and Hella was pushed back a few steps.

"Pugilist?" Hella narrowed her eyes and clasped her hands together. An even larger ghost face smashed towards Li Ya Lin.

Li Ya Lin was extremely calm. She slid under the ghost face and was only slightly affected by the aftershock. With her physique, she was completely able to withstand it. She once again closed in on Hella and slashed down with her Retractable Machete.

Hella was shocked and had no choice but to roll on the ground to avoid the blade.

Li Ya Lin used all her means. Every strike was filled with energy. Her long legs lashed out, slashed, kicked, and kicked. Her movements were as smooth as flowing water. She was like a nimble swallow dancing in the air. However, her attacks were like a torrential storm, overflowing with killing intent.

Spirit Swallow Style!

Hella's entire body was shrouded in a grey aura. Her arms acted as a shield, blocking every strike. She was unscathed. There was only one explanation for this. Hella's physical strength was far superior to Li Ya Lin's. Even in close-quarters combat, where Li Ya Lin specialized, she was not at a disadvantage.

This series of exchanges had only lasted a few seconds, but it was extremely dangerous.

"With the Mechanical Arm, the enemy will reveal a moment of weakness. Lambert will seize the opportunity to snipe!"

Li Yalin bit her lip and reached into her backpack with her left hand. When she took it out again, she was already equipped with the Lightweight Mechanical Arm. She threw a punch, and with the added strength of the Mechanical Arm, Hila's hands were knocked away, and her chest was exposed.

The Mechanical Arm sank into softness.

It was a solid hit!

A sickly flush appeared on Hila's face, and she groaned. She rubbed her hands together, and the grey air swirled around her palms at high speed, as if sparks were flying. Then, she pressed her hands down, and with her feet as the center, a strong wind blew in all directions, stirring up dust and sand!

Li Ya Lin hurriedly retreated. Even so, she felt as if her brain had been smashed by a heavy hammer. Her soul felt as if it was being torn apart. Her head was in extreme pain, and two streams of blood flowed out of her nose. Her vision tilted, and she almost lost her balance.

Hella stared at the familiar Lightweight Mechanical Arm. She was both shocked and angry. "What's your relationship with Zero?!"

Zero? Who? Li Ya Lin was confused.

Right at this moment, Lambert made his move. Grabbing this fleeting opportunity, he fired a shot. Hila's expression changed, and she quickly dodged to the side, using her gray energy to form a thick fog around her body. The large caliber bullet struck her shoulder, and Hila felt as if she had been hit by a speeding train. Her entire body spun as she was sent flying.

"Zhang Wei, take Li Ya Lin and run!"

Zhang Wei did not object to being called directly by his name. Under Han Xiao's command, Li Ya Lin and Lambert worked together to quickly injure the troublesome enemy. Zhang Wei began to trust Han Xiao's orders. Upon hearing Han Xiao's command, he immediately carried the dizzy Li Ya Lin, turned around, and ran toward Ma Qing Yang's car.

The Germinal Organization's armored vehicles rushed up the hill and opened fire. Zhang Wei's shield was hit, and sparks flew everywhere. He did not even dare to look back. At this moment, he was extremely grateful that he was wearing a huge metal suit. He used to complain about it being too heavy, but now, he felt very safe.

"Get in the car!" Ma Qing Yang looked back anxiously and quickly slowed down.

The three of them hurriedly jumped into the car. The car only stopped for two seconds before it was almost shot through.

Zhang Wei finally had time to observe the situation. The armored vehicles were not as fast as them, and the powerful Esper was treating her injuries. As long as they escaped to the plane, they could safely retreat.

"No problem!"

Zhang Wei breathed a sigh of relief.

Han Xiao poured cold water on him. "Be careful of the sky."

Sky?

Right, the enemy still has a helicopter!

Zhang Wei was shocked.

Tut, tut, tut —

The Black Harrier finally appeared. The machine gun on the helicopter chased after the car and fired.

"We have to shoot that thing down from the sky!" Zhang Wei made a quick decision. "Otherwise, our plane will be in danger. Only Lambert's sniper rifle has such a range!"

Lambert shook his head expressionlessly. "I've already used up all my armor-piercing bullets. I only have normal bullets left. The Black Harrier's armor is very thick. Even with armor-piercing bullets, it will take at least seven shots to penetrate the helicopter's armor."

"Are we going to die here?"

Ma Qing Yang's face was filled with despair. They were only one kilometer away from the retreating fighter jet, but it was like a chasm between heaven and earth.

Han Xiao suddenly interrupted. "Did you forget what I gave you?"

Li Ya Lin was stunned. She took out four clips, one of which was a sniper rifle. "What's the use of these?" she asked.

"You'll know when you try."

Without another word, Lambert reloaded his gun and fired at the helicopter.

Everyone looked on anxiously.

This bullet was the last hope of the world.

The flow of time seemed to slow down.

The bolt slid, and an empty brass shell was ejected. Fire and smoke spewed from the muzzle. The crimson bullet was pushed out of the muzzle by the kinetic energy of the primer. It spun, spun, and danced. Under the kinetic energy, the bullet kissed the helicopter's bulletproof glass.

The crimson bullet cracked open like a blooming lotus flower. A highly sticky, flammable gas quickly leaked out.

"Boom!"

The dazzling flames expanded, and the helicopter exploded into a huge fireball. The flames attached to the helicopter's armor, and it looked as if the armor had been set ablaze!

The helicopter flew around like a drunkard. The pilot panicked as his vision was blocked by the flames. He spun around and left the battlefield.

Everyone was shocked. They stared at the high-explosive bullets.

Even armor was set ablaze!

What kind of bullet was that?!

Ma Qing Yang was shocked. "Where did you get this good stuff?"

"We've found a treasure!" Li Ya Lin's eyes lit up. She quickly reloaded the high-explosive bullets of a different caliber. She raised her gun and fired. The high-explosive bullets turned a large number of off-road vehicles into fireballs. Even if they hit the ground, they would still create a sea of flames.

The enemy's armor was heated, and the temperature in the enemy's vehicles rose rapidly. The flames burned through the gaps in the vehicles, and the engines, cylinders, and other key components began to overheat. The pursuing vehicles quickly dodged and had no time to attack.

Lambert seized the opportunity and fired two more shots at the helicopter's rotor. The helicopter spun and left the battlefield.

Ma Qing Yang stepped on the accelerator and rushed into the back of the helicopter. The nervous pilot immediately took off, and the helicopter disappeared into the horizon.
